## 1. 中文标题 / English title

中文段落，一段只说一件事。

The English paragraph mirroring it, one idea per paragraph.

-   **中文条目。**\
    *English item.*
-   **中文条目。**\
    *English item.*

```{r}
#| label: fig-example
#| fig-cap: "中文图注。 | English caption."
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(blog_pal[["blue"]], blog_pal[["vermillion"]],
                                 blog_pal[["green"]])) +
  labs(x = "weight", y = "mpg", colour = NULL,
       title = "Title in English",
       subtitle = "short subtitle")
```
